messages:
jamie: Quick async — Bluefin private turn-up timeline. Staging mirror test targeted Thu EOD. Main open: customer firewall needs our outbound egress IP bundle and a maint window for image pull.
liam: @jamie I have the egress IPs ready, will paste in a CIDR list in a sec. their net team asked for a sample iptables rule example.
jamie: thanks. also we need an owner for the airgap artifact escrow step (signing + offline transfer).
sophia: I can own signing. I'll coordinate with security for key ceremony. need a point for courier/ops handoff.
irma: ops can handle the courier handoff if we have a manifest file and contact. please include a checksum and signing metadata.
jamie: nifty — sophia, can you drop the manifest schema? ops needs filename + sha256 + pk_sig.
sophia: schema below:
```
- filename
- size_bytes
- sha256
- signed_by: redwood-sec-pubkey-v2
- created_at
```
I'll attach example later.
liam: CIDRs (egress): 34.120.64.0/24, 35.199.12.0/24, 34.75.128.0/25. tell me if customer wants single IPs, we can NAT.
nik: PR ping — PR#4729 (onprem/agent: artifact ingestion backoff) needs review. This affects staging mirror reliability. Can infra/eng-runtime slot a quick review?
irma: noted @nik. ops will only need a smoke once PR lands. schedule a short canary window after deployment.
jamie: blocker: customer's staging cluster has a private DNS that blocks acme-staging.redwood-internal. Need a fallback cert plan. Ideas?
sophia: propose we ship a static cert bundle signed by our offline CA for the staging mirror. fallback: use host file mapping during mirror window. both documented in runbook.
liam: customer prefers no hostfile edits. static cert bundle is fine. sophia please add to runbook and include install steps.
ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance window request submitted for Bluefin on 1729090000 (Thu 23:00 UTC). Awaiting customer approval. :bell:
deploy-bot: CI passed for onprem-package v1.3.4; canary image pushed to staging-registry.
jamie: timeline check — if PR#4729 merges today and ops approves window, can we hit Thu EOD?
nik: yes, assuming no regression. I left a quick test matrix in the PR description: smoke + kv-cache replay + offline install.
irma: I'll reserve the courier slot for Fri morning as a fallback. note: courier requires signed manifest and contact phone.
sophia: assigning owners: signing=sophia, courier/hand-off=irma, egress IP list=liam, PR review=infra-team (nik/yael). I'll update the runbook.
liam: small ask — can someone from support verify the customer's NAT gateway allows 443 outbound to registry.gcp.redwood.com? support pinged infra earlier.
jamie: @support-team please confirm. if not, we need to stage images in a mirror inside their network (adds 2-4h).
nik: leaving a small debug snippet for infra reviewers:
```
# test registry reachability from customer host
curl -v https://registry.gcp.redwood.com/v2/_catalog 
# expected 200 or 401 with TLS handshake success
```
sophia: final note: I'll run a dry signing ceremony w/ sec on Wed. ppl invited: sophia, carol(sec), jamie. ops/nik welcome to observe.
jamie: perfect. we'll reconvene async here — drop short status messages only. :thumbsup:
